newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland sells PLN 192 mln 1-yr bonds.
newsitem.headline: Poland sells PLN 192 mln 1-yr bonds.

text.p: Poland sold to the public 192 million zlotys worth of one-year index-linked bonds maturing on March 4, 1998 at a subscription price of 95.5, the Public Debt Department said in a statement.

The one-year bond, with a coupon of three percentage points above year-on-year inflation two months before the first day of the public sale, was available to subscribers from January 20 to February 3, 1997.
It said unsold bonds from the 400 million zloty tranche would be available to the public from March 3 to May 28, 1997 at an issue price of 96.5 zlotys. @
At the last primary tender for institutional investors on January 28, the Treasury cut the minimum price of the one-year bonds to 93.50 and sold bonds worth 52 million zlotys.
